name: Onion Broth
description:
Slow-browned onions give this clear broth a deep amber colour. A little thyme rises with the steam; bread is ordered separately.

Sold as one 1 lb bowl of soup. Price and weight cover the food only; serving ware stays with the inn. Unlisted sides and drinks are separate.

weight.notes: Ready-to-eat portion, including bones or shells where stated for one complete sale unit; adjusted for Variant Encumbrance. The inn's serving vessel and cutlery are excluded.

name: Creamed Mushroom Soup
description:
